issue.description:
Split child 4 of 4 of beadrs-0d3c14c2; blocked by the COMMITS.md-write child. Lands the record commit. Terminal child: closing it satisfies the parent's push acceptance and unblocks beadrs-c54dcd5f (handoff) and the parent beadrs-0d3c14c2.

Steps:
1. Stage ONLY the record file: `git add pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md`. Never `git add -A`, never `git add .`, never `git commit -a`. Run `git status --short` before and after staging; confirm the staged set is exactly one path (expect unrelated dirty files - .beads/, docs/, notes/ - they stay unstaged).
2. Commit with a message naming the bead, e.g. `docs(pinned-binaries): record <short-sha> as the canonical feature-enabled build SHA (beadrs-0d3c14c2)`. Identity: jedarden <github@jedarden.com>.
3. `git push origin main`. If rejected as non-fast-forward, the lineage-reconcile child's invariant broke - stop, record state, leave open; never force-push.
4. Verify: `git status -sb` at 0/0; the commit is origin/main's tip or ancestor. Record BOTH the commit SHA and the recorded feature-enabled build SHA in notes - that note is what beadrs-c54dcd5f consumes.

Acceptance:
- A commit touching exactly pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md exists on origin main
- Staged path list was exactly one file (recorded in notes)
- Commit SHA + recorded build SHA both in notes
issue.title: Commit pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md by explicit path and push to origin main

issue.description:
AGENTS.md states 'Never claim compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite' and defines NEEDLE compatibility by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md, yet the only visible coverage is the one-off claim-epoch NEEDLE consumer canary (beadrs-41b9130e, BR-T27). Work needed: a versioned, runnable conformance suite asserting every contract behavior — command surface, exit codes, output shapes, checkpoint interchange expectations — wired into bead-rs-ci so contract drift fails the build rather than being discovered by a consumer.
